scope: Retrospective, cross-fitted training research using only the 24 registered 851c training games. Their aggregate 0/24 result and poor cross-map full-network gradient alignment were known before design. No independent development/validation matches, including 470/471, no new original games, and no formal maps used for training or selection.
data_binding: Require exactly 6 physical terrain hashes with both seats and both independently drawn original trajectories per map-seat, eligibility and SHA chain in ../hosted/training_manifest.json; use all rows. For each fold, every training and normalization operation gets only the five other terrains (20 complete episodes). A final reusable head is separately fit on all six after OOF scoring. It plays zero independent games in this task.
behavior: 851c creates the identical original pair of full orders using its real neural network, prefix rewrites, route and safety gate. Only when 851c would sample, replace its binary probability. Keep the order identities, menu ordering, 12 scheduled steps, 13 actual singleton roots, every deterministic ordinary move and RNG mechanism unchanged. Both outcomes remain strictly positive. Record original and new full-order similarities and likelihoods, expose any replay discrepancy.
features: Build a shared row for each proposed physical command from the same actor-visible pre-action observation. Global: turn, own/opponent bank and cargo, both worker and tree counts, focal worker role and cargo, focal current own/enemy base distance. Command-specific: signed difference between its parent logit and sibling logit, focal stay indicator and destination distances to both bases, nearest opponent/loaded opponent/other teammate, focal visible dst carbon, own/enemy tree at dst, number of nearby enemies and lower-cargo enemy collectors. Over the full proposed team: target overlaps, cargo tentatively delivered to own bases, weighted remaining home distance, enemy-tree planter stays, exposed loaded carriers, movement fraction, enemy-base occupancy. Board distance is toroidal Manhattan. Missing opponents have maximum board distance. No map/player IDs, future actions, examiner-private state, full carbon, hand-coded action bonus, rule changes, external data, previous match scores or remaining computation time as inputs.
architecture: Two order rows share one tanh hidden layer of width 8. A trainable readout scores each row. Delta log-odds for parent order 0 versus 1 = 0.25*tanh(score(features0)-score(features1)). Add to the exact frozen parent logit difference and re-normalize. Fixed feature normalizations independent of the corpus. One deterministic CPU float64 full-batch fit, hidden weights rng default_rng(7091) normal std 1/sqrt(d), hidden bias zero, readout zero (initial output identically zero).
optimization: Train hidden weights, hidden bias, and readout separately per fold. Exactly 32 full-batch Adam steps lr 0.02, betas .9/.999, eps 1e-8, no clipping or early stopping. Maximize sum of sibling advantages times changed chosen log likelihood / (12*n_episodes*mean_abs_episode_adv_on_fit), with zero at singleton/ordinary steps. Subtract 0.001 times the sum of each tensor's mean squared displacement from initialization. Inputs use verified emitted command, not a reconstructed sampled RNG draw. No model/feature/grid selection after out-of-fold outcomes.
out_of_fold: For each original terrain, use the fit on the 5 other complete terrains. Full trajectory weight is the uncapped product of q(actual order|public history)/p(actual order|public history). Ordinary and singleton steps carry ratio one. No marginal or root pseudo-replicates, no edits based on results, no outcome filtering, no self-normalization. For each held map-seat compute (W_A-W_B)*(U_A-U_B)/2. Report all 24 weights and returns, ESS=(sum W)^2/sum W^2, all 12 signed results, all 6 equal-map results, both seats, extrema, negative cases. This estimates a policy change in expected U at this opponent/host mixture; independent trajectories fit the sibling baseline. Six folds share training records, so uncertainty is descriptive.
gate: Mean paired change >0 and improvements on at least four of six held-out maps, with unchanged complete command support and matching actual-order replay. If this fails, publish negative evidence and keep the all-six training head as a research artifact. If it passes, separate fresh match and platform qualification remain necessary. No new games authorized by this preregistration.
